experiment.name: Shortened Quote Flow
experiment.hypothesis: Removing three quote steps increases completion, especially on mobile, without reducing policy conversion or increasing support demand beyond tolerance.
experiment.population: Eligible new quote starters; one assignment before the workflow opens.

financial_estimate.method: 3,000 unit bootstrap draws (percentile CI) · Welch p-value

reasons: Evidence, practical lift, financial downside, guardrails and planned sample size all pass the rollout rules.

quality_checks.name: No missing mature outcomes
quality_checks.detail: Missing mature results block rollout; non-converters remain in the denominator

quality_checks.name: Financial reconciliation
quality_checks.detail: Net unit value = gross policy value − incentives − variable cost

methodology.primary_adjustment: Bonferroni across three pre-specified primary hypotheses
methodology.guardrail_adjustment: Bonferroni one-sided noninferiority bounds within experiment
methodology.segment_adjustment: BH across all four exploratory dimensions
methodology.annualization: 12 acquisition cohorts, each valued over 12 policy months; not first-year recognized revenue
methodology.uncertainty: Sampling only; excludes uncertainty in traffic, policy valuation and rollout costs

experiment.name: Referral Incentive
experiment.hypothesis: A larger referral reward increases members generating a bound referral policy, with enough incremental policy value to pay for the higher reward on all qualifying referrals.
experiment.population: Existing eligible members, randomized before invitation; one invite opportunity and at most one rewarded policy per member.

financial_estimate.method: 3,000 unit bootstrap draws (percentile CI) · Welch p-value

reasons: Conversion evidence is positive, but the best estimate of modeled net contribution does not cover rollout costs. This is an economic decision, not proof that the true effect is negative.

experiment.name: Carrier Ranking Algorithm
experiment.hypothesis: Ranking carriers by expected conversion and economics improves policy conversion without materially reducing carrier match or increasing support demand.
experiment.population: Completed-quote shoppers eligible for carrier matching; assignment occurs before any carrier results are shown.

financial_estimate.method: 3,000 unit bootstrap draws (percentile CI) · Welch p-value

reasons: At least one arm is below the pre-specified sample target.
The primary improvement does not meet the family-adjusted evidence threshold.
Safety within tolerance is not established for: Support contact rate.
